result.reasoning: This commit refactored AbstractFile's validation logic, moving the `validatePathUniqueness` check out of `validatePath()` itself (where it previously guarded the entire uniqueness check) and only re-adding that guard around the new `validateAndRenameFileOnce()` call in `onCreation`. It failed to add the same guard to `onModification`, which still calls `validatePath()` unconditionally — causing the uniqueness validation to run on file renames/modifications even when `application.filesystem.unique.paths` is disabled. The fix commit directly restores the missing guard in `onModification`, matching the pattern this commit introduced in `onCreation`.
